text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following an excursion, Mejiro Bright
invites me
to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Here we are—the Lolita Fashion Expo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the day has finally arrived... Oh, how
I've
looked forward to this exhibition!
Trainer, is your
heart ready for this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'm glad to hear it. Shall we,
then? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how marvelous! This venue... Its
interior
design mirrors that of
Elizabethan churches!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see... This is a joint exhibit, for
both elegant
and classical lolita fashion
styles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Those styles take inspiration from the
clothing
worn by royalty and aristocrats
of the Middle
Ages and onward. So,
essentially...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if only I'd worn a dress. I could have
taken
such wonderful photos here.
choice_data_list: So it's meant to express that worldview, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I could've been photographed sitting in that elegant Victorian-style chair... Sigh... How delightful that would have been. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. ♪ This is a very special
place.
Coming here, I truly feel as if I've
stepped into a
wonderland.
choice_data_list: There's fun to be had just by taking part.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the cafe that was set up as part
of this
expo has made a name for itself
as a sweet Lolita
fashion cafe. But I
particularly recommend...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The Macaron Tower! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Very much so, yes! They're so cute.
Simply
looking at them soothes my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And unlike chocolate or ice cream, they
don't
melt, so I can enjoy them at my
leisure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to share a portion? We
can
replenish our energy before heading
to the next
exhibit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And here we have... the gothic Lolita
exhibit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But this area is still calming and chic. Its

atmosphere is similar to that of a
haunted house...
choice_data_list: This set looks like a ruin.
This set looks like a ruin, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, what's this? "O visitor, lift the veil
and
awaken the coffin's inhabitant from
its slumber."
So we simply have to lift
this veil?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it together, Trainer. Three...
Two...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, what a surprise. To think that a
skeleton
would emerge amidst a cloud
of smoke.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but my heart did leap, I assure you.
It jumped
as if this were a tense scene in
a fictional
adventure! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I wasn't expecting such thrilling
twists. How
delightful. Oh, how I'd love
to come here every
day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Gorgeous clothing, delicious treats, and

heart-pounding adventure. The day has
simply
flown by.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Thank you so very much for
today,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I had such a wondrous time, and it's all
because of
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To me, sharing the things I most
enjoy with
another feels particularly
special...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And extraordinarily magical.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Today, Trainer, you knocked on the
door to my
world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What will happen once it's open? How
will it feel
to spend time with you,
Trainer, in the world
within my heart?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! I feel as though I got a glimpse
at the
answers to those questions today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! I feel as though I got a glimpse
at the
answers to those questions today.
choice_data_list: Let's search for answers again sometime.
Bright's world seems really deep, doesn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's! There are still so many topics
I've yet to
share with you.
choice_data_list: Let's search for answers again sometime.
Bright's world seems really deep, doesn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As we've already covered dolls and
Lolita fashion
fairly thoroughly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Why don't we delve into antiques
and
history?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! My heart is beating even faster
than it
did in the haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wonder... You know, even I have
yet to
glimpse its boundaries.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I do have quite the appetite for
certain
things. I dream of attending
international doll
shows and fashion
exhibitions...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And if I were to visit Europe, seeing

Renaissance-era architecture and
sculptures and
whatnot would be a must!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As would taking commemorative
photographs of
my dolls at landmarks! ♪
My horizons remain ever
so bountiful!
